দাবিত্যাগ: - এই চ্যানেল কোনো অবৈধ কার্যকলাপকে প্রচার বা উৎসাহিত করে না। এই চ্যানেলের সমস্ত বিষয়বস্তু শুধুমাত্র শিক্ষামূলক এবং তথ্যমূলক উদ্দেশ্যে তৈরি। 

কপিরাইট দাবিত্যাগ: - কপিরাইট আইন ১৯৭৬-এর ১০৭ ধারা অনুযায়ী, সমালোচনা, মন্তব্য, সংবাদ প্রতিবেদন, শিক্ষাদান, বৃত্তি এবং গবেষণার মতো উদ্দেশ্যে ন্যায্য ব্যবহারের (FAIR USE) অনুমতি দেওয়া হয়েছে। ন্যায্য ব্যবহার হলো কপিরাইট আইন দ্বারা অনুমোদিত একটি ব্যবহার, যা অন্যথায় লঙ্ঘনকারী হতে পারে। অলাভজনক, শিক্ষামূলক বা ব্যক্তিগত ব্যবহারের ক্ষেত্রে ন্যায্য ব্যবহারের (FAIR USE) পাল্লা ভারী থাকে।

চ্যানেল ডিসক্লেইমার – কমিকভার্স হলো একটি পপ কালচার কমেন্টারি ও ফিল্ম রিভিউ চ্যানেল, যা ফ্যান থিওরি, ফিল্ম, ওয়েব সিরিজ এবং ট্রেলার পর্যালোচনার জন্য উৎসর্গীকৃত। কমিকভার্স চ্যানেল মাঝে মাঝে ফিল্ম, ওয়েব সিরিজ, ট্রেলার এবং গান সম্পর্কে ব্যাখ্যা করার জন্য ফিল্ম ক্লিপ, টিভি সিরিজ ক্লিপ, ওয়েব সিরিজ ক্লিপ, অ্যানিমেশন সিরিজ ক্লিপ ব্যবহার করে থাকে, কিন্তু ১৯৭৬ সালের কপিরাইট আইনের ১০৭ ধারা অনুযায়ী সমালোচনা, মন্তব্য, সংবাদ প্রতিবেদন, শিক্ষাদান, বৃত্তি এবং গবেষণার মতো উদ্দেশ্যে ন্যায্য ব্যবহারের (FAIR USE) অনুমতি দেওয়া হয়।

#ராமாயணம் #ராமாயணடிரெய்லர்விமர்சனம் #ரன்பீர்கபூர்

#ராமாயணம் #ராமாயணடிரெய்லர் #ராமாயணடிரெய்லர்விமர்சனம் #ராமாயணபொதுமக்கள்விமர்சனம் #பொதுமக்கள்எதிர்வினை #ராமாயணஎதிர்வினை #ரன்பீர்கபூர் #யஷ் #சாய்பல்லவி #சன்னிதியோல் #ராவணன் #இறைவன்ராமர் #நிதேஷ்திவாரி #பாலிவுட் #இந்தியசினிமா #திரைவிமர்சனம் #டிரெய்லர்விமர்சனம் #பொதுமக்கள்கருத்து #பார்வையாளர்கள்எதிர்வினை #வைரல் #ட்ரெண்டிங் #யூடியூப்இந்தியா #செய்திரட்டுகள் #சுபங்கர்மிஸ்ரா #ராமாயணதிரைப்படம்

snippet.title: Other Mommy | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Your mommy won’t save you. Other Mommy only in theaters October 9.

Can I go inside your heart?

From James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror behind the Saw, Insidious and The Conjuring franchises—and Rob Savage, the director of bold genre films Host and The Boogeyman, comes a terrifying trip into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

Academy Award® winner Jessica Chastain (It Chapter Two, The Eyes of Tammy Faye) stars in a dual role as Bela’s mother and as “Other Mommy,” a manifestation of the entity. Jay Duplass (Transparent, Industry) plays Daddo, Bela’s father, and Arabella Olivia Clark (The Housemaid, The Hand that Rocks the Cradle) plays Bela. 

The impressive supporting cast includes Actor Award nominee Dichen Lachman (Severance), Emmy and Tony Award nominee Arian Moayed (Succession) and screen legend Karen Allen (Indiana Jones films).  

From Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Other Mommy is directed by Rob Savage from a screenplay by WGA award winner Nathan Elston, writer for the Emmy-winning sensation Succession, based on the New York Times bestselling novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman (Bird Box).

The film is produced by James Wan, p.g.a., and is executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Rob Savage, Josh Malerman and Ryan Lewis. 

Social Handles
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/othermommy/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/othermommy/
TikTok: http://www.tiktok.com/@othermommy
Official Site: https://www.othermommymovie.com
#OtherMommy

Your mommy won’t save you. Other Mommy only in theaters October 9.

Can I go inside your heart?

From James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror behind the Saw, Insidious and The Conjuring franchises—and Rob Savage, the director of bold genre films Host and The Boogeyman, comes a terrifying trip into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

Academy Award® winner Jessica Chastain (It Chapter Two, The Eyes of Tammy Faye) stars in a dual role as Bela’s mother and as “Other Mommy,” a manifestation of the entity. Jay Duplass (Transparent, Industry) plays Daddo, Bela’s father, and Arabella Olivia Clark (The Housemaid, The Hand that Rocks the Cradle) plays Bela. 

The impressive supporting cast includes Actor Award nominee Dichen Lachman (Severance), Emmy and Tony Award nominee Arian Moayed (Succession) and screen legend Karen Allen (Indiana Jones films).  

From Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Other Mommy is directed by Rob Savage from a screenplay by WGA award winner Nathan Elston, writer for the Emmy-winning sensation Succession, based on the New York Times bestselling novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman (Bird Box).

The film is produced by James Wan, p.g.a., and is executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Rob Savage, Josh Malerman and Ryan Lewis.

snippet.title: क्लेफेस (Clayface) | Official Hindi Trailer
snippet.description:
मिलिए गोथम के नए चेहरे से। #ClayfaceMovie only in Cinemas on October 23 in English & Hindi.

Website: www.warnerbros-india.com
Facebook:   / warnerbrosindia  
Instagram:   / warnerbrosindia  
X: https://x.com/WarnerBrosIndia

DC Studios’ “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery.

Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

The film also stars Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan, as well as Nancy Carroll and Joshua James.

James Watkins directs from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, story by Flanagan, based on characters from DC. The film is produced by Matt Reeves, Lynn Harris, James Gunn and Peter Safran, with Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Rafi Crohn and Paul Ritchie executive producing.

Watkins’ creative team includes director of photography Rob Hardy, production designer James Price, editor Jon Harris and costume designer Keith Madden. Music is by Volker Bertelmann.

DC Studios Presents a 6th & Idaho Production, a James Watkins Film, “Clayface.” The film will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures and released only in Cinemas in India on October 23, 2026.

#WarnerBrosIndia #ClayfaceHindiTrailer

snippet.title: Farak - Taare | Official Music Video |
snippet.description:
“There are evenings when the whole world seems misaligned.
To be loved then is a miracle.” - Franz Kafka

"Taare" is a part of Diwaar Ke Uss Paar, the second half of a story that began with Diwaar Ke Is Paar. Thank you for listening.

Listen on Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/track/2iVj11OdEBNIGUv9f7jGPK?si=inzh6JX8SxuCWRGbq-gx0A


Lyrics -

Humara thokaron se kuch purana khaas naata hai
Hai jisne ishq hi dekha na vo rab ka dulara hai

Humara thokaron se kuch purana khaas naata hai
Hai jisne ishq hi dekha na vo rab ka dulara hai

Ab Haal-e-dil to na poocho 
batate dar sa lagta hai
Is khaali ghar ko na looto
ye buzdil sar patakta hai

Vo ghar chhoota hai jab se Kambhakhat koi aasra na hai
Ye kaagaz kaanpta jab hote dil ke ghaav taaza hain

Ke lafz kuch aise hain
Gawaya is qadar ke
Gaur farmaiyega
Gawaya is qadar ke
Paane ko ab kuch bacha na hai
Parinda kaid pinjre mein
Parinda kaid pinjre mein
Use dar aasmaan ka hai


Gawaya is qadar ke paane ko ab kuch bacha na hai
parinda kaid pinjre mein use dar aasmaan ka hai

Jo bikhra toot ke fir vo
Samete na simat ta hai
Hain partein is qadar dil pe
Taraashe na nikharta hai

Halaaton se liya jab bair to har, daav haara main
Asal mein jeena mushkil Maut ka bas naam zyada hai
Ye kandhe jhuk rahe hai ummeedon ka bhaar zyaada hai

Andhere mein pala jo dar use bas roshni ka hai
Asal mein jeena mushkil maut ka bas naam zyada hai

snippet.title: 20 July, 2026 | Spain vs argentina | FIFA World Cup 26 Final | Football | FC26 Gameplay
snippet.description:
✅ The Ultimate Glory: Spain vs. Argentina | FIFA World Cup 2026 Grand Final Simulation

This is it—the ultimate footballing spectacle! Witness history in the making as Spain clashes with Argentina in the Grand Final of the FIFA World Cup 2026, fully simulated in EA Sports FC 26! After weeks of grueling battles, only two nations remain standing on the world’s biggest stage. With the legendary golden trophy on the line, the stage is set for a historic, breathtaking finale that will define legacies forever.

Spain enters the pitch looking to reclaim world dominance through their mesmerizing possession, high-pressing discipline, and youthful exuberance. Standing in their way is the reigning world champions, Argentina—a side fueled by unmatched passion, tactical perfection, and the relentless desire to defend their crown.

More than just a match, this is a clash of generations and footballing titans. Spain unleashes their phenomenal tactical blueprint, driven by the generational magic of Lamine Yamal, the flawless midfield mastery of Rodri, and the clinical, clutch presence of Mikel Oyarzabal. Meanwhile, Argentina counters with their iconic powerhouse spine, featuring the timeless genius of Lionel Messi, the lethal attacking instincts of Lautaro Martínez, and the tireless, elite midfield engine of Alexis Mac Allister.

✅ Will Spain’s brilliant tactical masterclass led by Yamal and Rodri conquer the world, or can Argentina’s golden generation—spearheaded by the magic of Messi—secure back-to-back world titles in a historic final victory?

If you enjoy hyper-realistic match simulations and in-depth tactical storytelling, don't forget to hit the like button and subscribe to our channel for more World Cup 2026 action!

Thank you for watching, and welcome to the Grand Final! 🏆⚽

snippet.title: Karpur Gauram Karunavtaram | कर्पूर गौरम् करुणावतारम् | Shiv Mantra for Calm | Peaceful Shiva Mantra
snippet.description:
Click to Subscribe :- https://bit.ly/3xeS2N0
Karpur Gauram Karunavtaram | कर्पूर गौरम् करुणावतारम् | Shiv Mantra for Calm | Peaceful Shiva Mantra


“Karpur Gauram Karunavtaram” is a timeless Shiva prayer — a powerful mantra that praises Mahadev’s pure, compassionate form and brings deep calm to the mind. This chant is widely listened to for peace of mind, emotional balance, and spiritual grounding, especially during stressful times or daily sadhana.

कर्पूर गौरम् करुणावतारम् | Karpur Gauram Karunavtaram — भगवान शिव को समर्पित यह अत्यंत पवित्र और शक्तिशाली मंत्र किसी भी पूजा, आरती या ध्यान के समापन पर बोला जाता है। यह मंत्र मन में शांति, भक्ति और दिव्य शक्ति का संचार करता है। Sanatan Music पर इस Powerful Shiv Mantra को सुनें और महादेव की कृपा पाएं।

🕉️ कर्पूर गौरम् — Sanskrit Mantra (मंत्र)
कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारम्
संसारसारम् भुजगेन्द्रहारम्।
सदावसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे
भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि॥

(Karpura-Gauram Karunavataram
Samsara-Saram Bhujagendra-Haram |
Sada-Vasantam Hridaya-Aravinde
Bhavam Bhavani-Sahitam Namami ||)

🙏 अर्थ (Meaning in Hindi & English)
हिंदी: जो कर्पूर (कपूर) की तरह श्वेत और शुद्ध हैं, करुणा के अवतार हैं, संसार के सार हैं, सर्प को हार की तरह धारण करते हैं, और जो सदा माता भवानी (पार्वती) के साथ हमारे हृदय-कमल में विराजमान रहते हैं — उन्हें मैं नमन करता हूं।

snippet.title: राम जी रहम करि (4K) #Mani Meraj, #Chand Jee, #Shilpi Raj | Ram Ji Raham Kari | New #Bhojpuri Song
snippet.description:
भोजपुरी जगत का एक और धमाकेदार और दिल छू लेने वाला गाना "राम जी रहम करि" अब आप सभी के बीच आ चुका है। इस गाने में भोजपुरी के मशहूर कॉमेडी किंग मनी मेराज (Mani Meraj) और चाँद जी (Chand Jee) का बेहतरीन अंदाज देखने को मिल रहा है। इस खूबसूरत गाने को अपनी जादुई आवाज से सजाया है ट्रेंडिंग सिंगर शिल्पी राज (Shilpi Raj) ने।

snippet.title: Jiwana Maya
snippet.description:
The song “जीवनमाया” reflects on the fragile, uncertain, and deeply emotional nature of life and
love.
At its core, it speaks about how life is temporary and unpredictable—filled with moments of
happiness and sorrow that coexist. The lyrics encourage living joyfully in the present (“laugh and
let this moment pass in happiness”), while acknowledging that nothing is permanent: if we meet
again, it will be a reunion; if not, memories will remain.
The song also touches on fate and helplessness, suggesting that certain things in life are already
written and cannot be changed, no matter how much we try. It warns against over-idealizing love
or blindly trusting everything (“don’t treat thorns like flowers”), emphasizing that love exists
alongside pain, loss, and emotional risk.
Overall, “जीवनमाया” is a reflective and philosophical piece about:
-the impermanence of life
-the bittersweet nature of love
-acceptance of destiny
-and the importance of cherishing present moments without fear of tomorrow
It leaves the listener with a gentle but emotional reminder: live, love, and accept that separation
and memory are both part of human experience.

bn.title: স্পেন বনাম আর্জেন্টিনা | বিশ্বকাপ ২০২৬ | পেনাল্টি শুটআউট | ভিডিও গেম সিমুলেশন
bn.description:
এই ভিডিওতে আপনারা PES 2021 দ্বারা অনুপ্রাণিত ফুটবল গেমপ্লে দেখতে পাবেন। অনুগ্রহ করে মনে রাখবেন যে এটি গেমটির অফিসিয়াল বা আসল সংস্করণ নয়। এই কন্টেন্টটি সম্পূর্ণরূপে বিনোদনের উদ্দেশ্যে তৈরি করা হয়েছে।

আমাদের লক্ষ্য হলো আপনাদের জন্য মজার ফুটবল মুহূর্ত, সৃজনশীল ম্যাচ, উত্তেজনাপূর্ণ গোল এবং অনন্য গেমপ্লের অভিজ্ঞতা নিয়ে আসা। আপনারা যা কিছু দেখছেন, তার সবই মজা এবং আনন্দের জন্য তৈরি।

আপনি যদি ফুটবল গেম এবং বিনোদনমূলক কন্টেন্ট পছন্দ করেন, তাহলে আরও ভিডিওর জন্য 90 + line-কে লাইক, কমেন্ট এবং সাবস্ক্রাইব করতে ভুলবেন না!

te.title: స్పెయిన్ vs అర్జెంటీనా | వరల్డ్ కప్ 2026 | పెనాల్టీ షూటౌట్ | వీడియో గేమ్ సిమ్యులేషన్
te.description:
ఈ వీడియోలో, మీరు PES 2021 స్ఫూర్తితో రూపొందించిన ఫుట్‌బాల్ గేమ్‌ప్లేను చూస్తారు. దయచేసి గమనించండి, ఇది గేమ్ యొక్క అధికారిక లేదా అసలైన వెర్షన్ కాదు. ఈ కంటెంట్ కేవలం వినోదం కోసం మాత్రమే రూపొందించబడింది.

మీకు సరదా ఫుట్‌బాల్ క్షణాలు, సృజనాత్మక మ్యాచ్‌లు, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన గోల్స్ మరియు ప్రత్యేకమైన గేమ్‌ప్లే అనుభవాలను అందించడమే మా లక్ష్యం. మీరు చూసే ప్రతిదీ వినోదం మరియు ఆనందం కోసమే తయారు చేయబడింది.

మీరు ఫుట్‌బాల్ గేమ్‌లను మరియు వినోదాత్మక కంటెంట్‌ను ఇష్టపడితే, మరిన్ని వీడియోల కోసం 90+lineకు తప్పకుండా లైక్, కామెంట్ మరియు సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ చేసుకోండి!
